$comment: Configuration for the codertapsu fork's tarball releases.
Bump `revision` for every release built from the same upstream version.
Each package is published as <itsUpstreamVersion>-<tag>.<revision> (the bases differ:
the release tag comes from @excalidraw/excalidraw, e.g. v0.18.0-codertapsu.8.
Revisions 1-7 were published as tarballs committed to git and installed from
raw.githubusercontent.com — superseded by immutable release assets from revision 8 on.
IMPORTANT: never republish a release tag — npm caches by URL and lockfiles pin an
integrity hash, so consumers would fail with EINTEGRITY. Bump `revision` instead.
